titles: What Are AI Skills, Tools & Memory?
youtube.description:
Tanyi explains how skills, tools and memory give an AI model hands and a mind. Watch Kito build the Friday report system with Ndedi's procedures, map tools and notes files. Learn to separate rules from findings in your own systems.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:21 Listening
0:43 Understand: the three parts
1:08 Decide: what goes where
1:33 Build
2:03 Constraint and fix
2:32 User test
2:50 Where this applies
3:01 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
